variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: JWT signing key for dashboard session tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: API_KEY_SECRET
variables.description: Encryption key for API keys stored in the database. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: INITIAL_PASSWORD
variables.description: Initial admin login password. Change this after first login via Dashboard → Settings → Security

variables.name: DATA_DIR
variables.description: Data directory for SQLite database and storage (must match volume mount)

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port for Dashboard UI and API (single-port mode)
